_meta.philosophy: All tax/immigration/customs data is publicly available because it is funded by taxpayers. No government should restrict public access to public data. This calculator is built entirely from public sources to demonstrate that.

scenarios.scenario_name: US SaaS startup, 8 US + 2 CA employees, $2M revenue, 80% US / 20% CA

recommended_structure.structure: US HQ with Canadian EOR (Employer of Record)
recommended_structure.rationale: Avoid CA entity formation; use EOR for 1-3 CA employees until growth justifies subsidiary.

friction_breakdown.description: Estimated cost to hedge CAD/USD exposure on $600,000 of Canadian revenue and salaries
friction_breakdown.source: Bank of Canada daily exchange rates + industry estimates

friction_breakdown.description: US entity with 2 Canadian employees creates Canadian Permanent Establishment. Must file T2 corporate tax return, pay BC corporate tax (27%) on Canadian-source income, register for GST/HST if >$30k CA revenue.
requirements: Register CA business number with CRA
File T2 corporate tax return annually
Register for GST/HST if CA revenue > $30k
Transfer pricing documentation (OECD-compliant)
Form 5471 (US) if foreign subsidiary structure used

friction_breakdown.description: Work authorization for cross-border employees (8 US + 2 CA)

recommended_pathways.best_for: Canadian citizens in TN-listed occupations (engineer, scientist, etc.)
recommended_pathways.caveat: TD spouse visa does NOT allow work; consider L-1 or H-1B if spouse needs to work

friction_breakdown.description: US employer-sponsored health insurance (8 × $8,500) + BC Employer Health Tax (1.95% on CA payroll above $500k)
PIPEDA (Canada) + state privacy law compliance. Cross-border data transfer requires appropriate safeguards; consent may be required for sensitive data.
friction_breakdown.source: Office of the Privacy Commissioner of Canada + NCSL
requirements: Privacy policy must disclose cross-border data transfers
PIPEDA consent for collection, use, disclosure of personal information
Data Processing Agreement (DPA) with any sub-processors
State privacy law compliance (CCPA/CPRA if CA customers; WPA if WA customers post-2024)

friction_breakdown.description: Running payroll in both US and Canada requires either EOR (Employer of Record) service or dual entity structure. EOR cost ~$500-600/employee/month; entity setup $5-15k one-time.
friction_breakdown.source: Industry estimates (Deel, Rippling, Velocity Global public pricing)

provenance.data_sources_summary: All tax/immigration/customs data from public taxpayer-funded sources (IRS, CRA, USCIS, IRCC, USMCA, HTSUS, BC statutes). Healthcare data from KFF + BC Ministry of Health. Currency data from Bank of Canada.
v2_roadmap: Interactive UI for founders to input their own parameters
Sector-specific multipliers (saas vs hardware vs retail)
Scenario modeling: 'What if we add 5 CA employees next year?'
